result.topic_en: This is not mathematics but a heavily corrected pencil draft of letters. In German, it concerns a crate shipped by the Valéry steamship company via Marseille to Livorno that had not been delivered. In French, it addresses Monsieur Angelo Alhaique in Livorno about presenting a letter of credit from Mrs Baur of Altona.
